thought.text: Let me stop the forego process group (parent) and its children, then do a clean search index rebuild:

reasoning_content:
Let me organize this. I'll terminate the forego process group (20728). Forego is the parent process. If I terminate 20728, the child processes should also terminate, but let's make sure we reliably terminate the entire process group. I'll terminate forego (20728), and if there are any remaining child processes, I'll terminate them individually.

In practice, as a safer approach, let's terminate the process group of forego. I'll use kill on PID 20728 and, if necessary, on its child processes as well.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
kill 20728 2>/dev/null
sleep 3
# kill any stragglers by exact pid
for pid in 20739 20740 20741 20742 20743; do kill $pid 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 2
ps aux | grep -E "forego|puma|vite|background-worker|websocket-server|rails server|dartsass" | grep -v grep | awk "{print \$2, \$11, \$12}" || echo "ALL_STOPPED"
'
